items.name: Secret scan
items.description: Scan staged changes, a branch diff or the whole repo for leaked secrets and forbidden files before committing.

items.name: Integration test scenario
items.description: Create or extend integration-test scenarios and test-case specs under tests/IT/senarios in the 4PM layout.

items.name: Progress report
items.description: Write a fact-based daily or date-range progress report into reports/ from git activity and the 4PM done book.

items.name: Code reviewer
items.description: Read-only reviewer that verifies and ranks correctness and security findings in a diff, branch or PR.

items.name: Prune merged branches
items.description: Delete local git branches already merged into the base branch (dry run by default).

items.name: Prune merged branches (VS Code tasks)
items.description: VS Code tasks to list or delete local branches already merged into the base branch.

items.name: Commit message
items.description: Claude slash command that drafts a Conventional Commits message from the staged changes.

items.name: Bash guard
items.description: PreToolUse hook that blocks destructive shell commands (rm -rf /, force push, push to main, curl|sh, printing secret files).

items.name: Agent working rules
items.description: General working rules for AI coding agents — security first, small focused changes, verified with tests, safe git.

items.name: Git housekeeping
items.description: Prune merged branches (script + VS Code tasks) and draft commit messages with /commit-message.

items.name: 4PM doc lint
items.description: Check and fix docs against the 4PM Doc Header standard (kinds, ids, parent/refs links, nesting depth) and code file headers; the dashboard Graph builds on it.

items.name: Marketing video template
items.description: Remotion project 4PM scaffolds for a project's marketing video: scenes over photo-run screenshots, captions per locale, transitions, a synthesized or uploaded soundtrack, one mp4 + poster per locale.
